item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Westwood and Vandegrift displace 26-6A leaders atop Austin Boys rankings
item.description: How do you logically rank teams when stuff like this happens? Westlake upended previously top-ranked Bowie by 11 points – but then Lake Travis knocked off the Chaps in an overtime thriller. For now, the Cavs, Chaps and Bulldogs line up in that order – but all three now sit behind Westwood and Vandegrift, who play each other in a titanic 25-6A clash Tuesday night (1/13).Ah, the joys of district play.East View got the short end of the stick.
